$comment: The landing page's example tabs. Each fixture line gets the card part it builds (for hover highlighting) and a plain-language explanation. Run `npm run landing:examples` after changing a fixture or this file.

lines.explain: The whole screen is one card. Its six parts are listed here and arrive on the lines below.
A photo, named from the app’s own picture list. The model can’t give a web address, so a stream can never load an image from somewhere else.
The listing name, shown as a heading.
A star rating. The app draws the stars and reads the score aloud for screen readers.
The location as quieter text. Tone comes from a fixed list; the model can’t write its own styles.
A row holding the two date fields. A date range is simply two DateInputs.
State holding the check-in date, written YYYY-MM-DD.
A date picker the guest can change. Picking a day updates $checkIn.
State holding the check-out date.
The second date picker, bound to $checkOut.
The Reserve button. It has an action, so it stays disabled until the next line approves it.
Links the button to one tool the app allows and sends both dates. The app checks the tool and the dates before anything runs.
One card for the bag, listing its four parts.
The screen’s heading.
A list. It may hold only list items, and the parser rejects anything else.
One item: title, details, price and a thumbnail from the app’s picture list.
The second item. Items are written out one by one; there are no loops.
The total, formatted as dollars by the app. Omni-IR has no formulas, so the number is given, never calculated.
The Pay button. It stays disabled until the next line approves it.
Allows exactly one action, payments.confirm, with the amount to charge. The server checks it again before running it.
One card for the conversation and the question box.
The screen’s heading.
A column holding the conversation so far.
The guest’s question, as a chat message. The app styles it and tells screen readers who sent it.
The assistant’s reply. Messages are plain text: markup in them is shown, never run.
State for the next question, starting empty.
A labelled text box. Typing updates $question.
The Send button. It stays disabled until the next line approves it.
Sends the typed question to the one tool the app allows for this.
